heading_en: Minimum Required Observation Period for LGD Estimation of Corporate, etc. Exposures
summary_ja: 先進的内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社の事業法人等向けLGD推計の七年以上の観測期間を定める。
summary_en: Requires an AIRB UDPC to use data covering at least seven years to estimate LGD for corporate, etc. exposures, preferring the longest period.
paragraphs: In estimating the LGD of corporate, etc. exposures to which the advanced internal ratings-based approach may be applied, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach shall use one or more of external data, internal data, or data pooled among multiple financial institutions, covering an observation period of seven years or more.

Where there are multiple sets of data covering the observation period prescribed in the preceding paragraph, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach shall use the data covering the longest observation period; provided, however, that this does not apply to data of low relevance in estimating LGD.
